name: Executive Summary Slide
description: Produces an executive summary slide design with a three-panel layout covering situation, insight, and recommendation, including data points for each panel and a one-sentence version of each. Use when the user asks to create an executive summary slide, a situation-insight-recommendation overview, or a one-slide briefing for leadership. Do NOT use for full slide deck structure (use slide-deck-structure), pitch deck design (use pitch-deck-structure), or data chart selection (use data-in-slides).
